title: Dallas Willard- Renovaré 1 - Part 2 - The Theology of Spiritual Formation

playlist.playlist_description:
The Renovaré Institute for Christian Spiritual Formation is a two-year online and in-person school that provides students with a solid framework for understanding and living out Christian Spiritual Formation. For the first 3 years of the Institute, Dallas was able to teach 2 residency weeks per year. This series was recorded during the first residency week of the second cohort in October 2010. Please refer to the “Living in the Divine Conversation and Character” playlist for Dallas's teaching in the next residency week, March 2011.

We are grateful to our friends at Renovaré for allowing us to post these series on our channel. To learn more about the Institute, please visit https://renovare.org/institute. New cohorts begin every year in August.
